title: Legacy RV Park

services.name: Campsite Activities
services.desc: Take a refreshing dip in our pool and enjoy the warm Southern Utah sunshine. It's the perfect place to cool off, unwind, and relax after a day of exploring. Enjoy a friendly game of pickleball on our on-site court. Whether you're a seasoned player or trying it for the first time, it's a great way to stay active and have fun during your stay. Sit back, relax, and connect with friends and family in our comfortable lounge area. It's the perfect place to unwind, socialize, or simply enjoy the peaceful atmosphere of the park. Your four-legged family members deserve a vacation too. Our fenced dog park provides a safe space for pets to run, play, and burn off

blurb: If you’re looking for the perfect blend of comfort, scenery, and adventure, Legacy RV Park in Hurricane, Utah is the ideal place to stay.
